name: Image Sets Date-Based Sequence Detection
changes: Recognize Image Sets with leading counters followed by the same YYYY-MM-DD date label, including hyphen, underscore and dot separators.
Interpret sequence counters before trailing dates so 0001_2026-06-05.png and 0002_2026-06-05.png share one set key.
Reject invalid calendar dates, year-like leading counters and date-only names as sequence evidence.
Preserve standard trailing-number, leading-number and subject index/total detection; maintain poster/newsgroup/media-kind isolation.
regression_guards: Positive/negative/legacy Image Sets classifier tests and browser ON/OFF behavior.
Preserve v3.7.19 media scan I/O cache and regression checks.
Preserve v3.7.17 filename, v3.7.16 video console, v3.7.15 filter/queue, v3.7.14 Completed history, v3.7.13 gallery.
preserved: No changes to NNTP, SABnzbd 5.1.2, SABCTools 9.6.3, Automation scans, Smart Import, Downloads, or Metadata Server.
Existing Image Sets enable/disable controls and minimum member count are unchanged.
